_note: Data for the programs J2 builds and runs (read by j2.py, beside it). requester_only: what Decide for me never answers, whatever the kind of the question: each row is a pattern (whole words, any case) looked for in the open question, its options and Identity's message, and `about`, the plain words the chat line gives as the reason. Code adds two checks that read no words: a question tagged with a done-when item a planned real run decides, and a decision whose leave-out option names such an item. run_output: the record code writes after an approved real run (folder: where, in the run folder; label, name, tag and color: its row in artifacts.json; output_chars: the end of stdout and of stderr kept; text_bytes: the largest text file whose contents are kept; files: the most files listed).

requester_only.about: the folder a real run uses
